name: Birdcage Pandemonium
source:
Violet wakes up in a mansion with no recollection of who she is. Bound to chains and armed with only a dagger, she roams the halls in search of herself. 

Can she find her way out of the mansion? Or will she endlessly roam around the mansion until her untimely death. After all she’s not the only one roaming the halls in search of something.

[From [url=https://niihi3.itch.io/birdcage-pand]itch.io[/url]]
